issues.name: Agent-friendly 404s
issues.details: Nonexistent paths return HTTP 200 with the app shell (soft-404). Agents probing for resources conclude every path exists. Return a real HTTP 404 status for unknown paths.
issues.recommendation: Return a real HTTP 404 (or 410) status for nonexistent paths - never a 200 with your app shell.

issues.name: MCP server / manifest
issues.details: MCP server live at /mcp but initialize requires authentication (HTTP 307 redirect).
issues.recommendation: Build an MCP (Model Context Protocol) server exposing your API as tools. Use Streamable HTTP transport for full score. This lets Claude, ChatGPT, and other AI agents call your product natively.

issues.name: Agent instruction / when-to-use
issues.details: Instruction file at /agents.md found but no when-to-use guidance.
issues.recommendation: Tell agents when to reach for you: add a 'when to use this' section to your llms.txt (or a dedicated agent-instructions file) that names your best-fit use cases and how an agent should call you. Be specific about the jobs you are right for - generic marketing copy does not read as guidance.

issues.name: Rate limit response headers
issues.details: No live rate-limit headers on API responses.
issues.recommendation: Return RateLimit-* headers so agents can pace requests.

issues.name: Function calling compatibility
issues.details: Operation descriptions sparse (ratio 0.94) — add per-operation summaries for tool use.
issues.recommendation: Ensure API endpoints have unique operation IDs, typed schemas, and descriptions compatible with LLM function-calling formats.
